column1: # KEEP preserves an existing owner; DEFER admits no donor implementation; REJECT applies only to the stated use. No row declares full fork qualification.

column9: rationale
Extend existing NIO owner with bounded streaming SHA-256; preserve provider, nofollow and resource lifetime; do not decode class bytes.
Compare retained immutable UTF-16 source exactly; retain URI and unknown byte identity; range evidence alone does not authorize AST reuse.
Add detached identity-difference mask; preserve record and hash protocol; source equality cannot erase context/provider/schema/phase changes.
Keep live views event-scoped on the actual compiler task; detached immutable projections may outlive the task under complete identity; no second javac parse.
Reuse existing context and projection cache ownership; detached build-fact admission remains pending.
Reuse existing snapshot publication owner for future successful generations; this candidate adds no persistence or publication mechanism.
Preserve standard compile/testCompile activation, expression evaluation, original toolchain and processor behavior; activation is not incremental task planning.
Keep Gradle input/property semantics; admission of shared M3 fingerprints requires task-specific qualification.
Reuse class-file-hash keyed analysis; do not create a parallel class-analysis cache.
Retain source-to-class and constant-dependent mappings; raw class fingerprints do not replace compiler dependency facts.
Reuse watcher lifecycle and continuity handling; absent events are not independent proof of unchanged content.
Existing source/options/dependency selection is distinct from ABI tracking; qualify replacing observations without weakening processor or output invalidation.
Reuse effective-model, input-path/content and dependency/plugin hashing semantics; shared delta consumption and restored-output validation remain pending.
Existing JAR watcher invalidation including overflow is a donor; qualify M3 snapshot identity and daemon reuse before integration.
mtime/fileKey equality alone cannot satisfy authoritative M3 content-change detection; retain same-size/same-time counterexamples.

Evaluate graph-based incremental compilation against existing M3 and Gradle facts; not a released capability or admitted implementation. Review: https://github.com/apache/maven-compiler-plugin/pull/1162
Evaluate signature/implementation dependency split, constants, generics and module declarations; ABI extraction remains pending. Review: https://github.com/apache/maven-compiler-plugin/pull/1163
Evaluate manifests and external ABI resolution; proposed size+mtime JAR reuse does not meet the M3 content-identity contract. Review: https://github.com/apache/maven-compiler-plugin/pull/1164

Evaluate isolating/aggregating/unknown processor evidence and Gradle metadata compatibility; unknown processors require conservative invalidation. Review: https://github.com/apache/maven-compiler-plugin/pull/1165
Existing owners and tool planners already supply these responsibilities; the candidate adds only source/file/context evidence.
